description: This Java class implements a connection factory that provides access to disconnect handlers in an AMQP client context. It manages connection attempts, including simulated failures, and allows registration of disconnect and close handlers, primarily used for testing or simulation purposes within the Eclipse Hono project.

classes.name: DisconnectHandlerProvidingConnectionFactory
classes.description: A Java class that implements a connection factory providing external handlers for disconnect events and simulating connection behaviors, used in testing scenarios within the Eclipse Hono framework.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Overloaded method to initiate a connection with optional username and password, attaching provided close and disconnect handlers, and completing asynchronously.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name identifier for this connection factory, which is 'client'.

methods.name: getHost
methods.description: Returns the hostname associated with this connection factory, which is 'server'.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Returns the port number assigned to this factory, obtained from Constants.PORT_AMQP.

methods.name: getPathSeparator
methods.description: Returns the path separator constant, used for AMQP resource paths.

methods.name: getDisconnectHandler
methods.description: Returns the handler responsible for handling disconnect events on the connection.

methods.name: getCloseHandler
methods.description: Returns the handler invoked when the peer closes the connection.

methods.name: setExpectedFailingConnectionAttempts
methods.description: Configures how many connection attempts should fail before success, primarily for testing, returning the factory instance for chaining.

methods.name: setExpectedSucceedingConnectionAttempts
methods.description: Sets how many successful connection attempts are expected, returning the factory instance for method chaining.

methods.name: failWith
methods.description: Defines the Throwable cause for connection failure scenarios.

methods.name: await
methods.description: Blocks until the expected number of successful connection attempts occur, returning true if succeeded.

methods.name: awaitFailure
methods.description: Blocks until the expected number of failed connection attempts occur, returning true if succeeded.
